title: Business system brief
summary: A field-by-field brief for scoping websites, CRMs, dashboards, automations and AI workflow assistants before design starts.
body: Use this guide to capture business goals, users, entities, source systems, workflows, reporting needs, AI touchpoints, edge cases and launch constraints.

title: CRM readiness checklist
summary: A checklist for deciding whether your team needs spreadsheet cleanup, a lightweight CRM, CRM automation or a custom pipeline system.
body: Before building a CRM, check ownership, lead sources, required stages, follow-up rules, routing logic, required integrations, data quality and reporting obligations.

title: Automation map
summary: A simple worksheet for documenting triggers, actions, AI steps, failure states and visibility across automation workflows.
body: Every automation should define its trigger, data contract, owner, retries, notifications, AI review points and manual fallback path.
